chapters.label: Extra time
chapters.text: Wembley, 1968, the European Cup final against Benfica, extra time. The keeper kicks it long, Kidd heads it on, and George Best, in blue, races past the defence! Round the keeper, and... goal!

chapters.label: The dummy
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Keeper Henrique rushes out. Best drops his shoulder one way, the keeper is fooled, and one touch takes it round him.

chapters.label: No rush
chapters.text: The goal is empty. No rush: Best calmly rolls it in with his left foot!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: one on one, fake one way, touch it round the keeper, pass it in calmly.
